years_experience: Trading since 2006 (locally owned and operated by Simon and Fiona Cavanagh)
other_info: Timber and building supply merchant at 138 Napier Road, Palmerston North, part of the BuildLink Group (buying power). 10 staff plus a full-time in-house builder who makes sheds, animal shelters, trellis, sleepouts, cabins, hot houses and outdoor furniture to order. Delivers across Manawatu and Lower North Island. Categories: pole sheds, through post and rail fencing, timber, ply and plaster, hardware, made to order. Open Mon-Fri 7:30-5, Sat 8-1. Logo still needed (compulsory).
